currentContext.expansion: The annual report describes no named capex project, new plant or dated commissioning schedule. Expansion is framed as capability building rather than greenfield capacity: management says it is continuing investments in manufacturing capability, automation and quality systems, and is focusing on operational improvements through ongoing investments in manufacturing capability, automation, process optimization and employee skill development. Several initiatives undertaken during FY2025-26 to improve productivity, quality and capacity are expected to contribute to improved operating efficiencies in the coming years. Capacity itself was a binding constraint during the year: margin expansion was moderated by higher outsourced manufacturing costs arising from capacity constraints, and management continues to focus on increasing capacity utilisation alongside optimising manufacturing costs. Serial production of certain recently developed parts ramped up over the course of the year, and the Company is accelerating commercialization of products currently under development. Efficiency work underway includes better utilization of equipment, improved power consumption, optimization of tooling costs and increased reuse of packaging materials.
